leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Initialize a PerformanceObserver to monitor long tasks
Configure the observer to detect tasks exceeding 50ms threshold
Implement a callback function to process long task entries
Construct a display function to render performance data in the DOM
Integrate the observer with event handlers for user interaction
Manipulate the observer lifecycle to start and stop monitoring
Apply the profiler to identify performance bottlenecks in sample code
lessonTitle: Build long task profiler using performance API
